prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit quickly if you tell me a bit more, but here’s a short guide to get started.

Quick questions
- What kind of marketing do you need? (brand/creative, digital/paid, SEO/content, social, B2B lead gen, PR, full-service, etc.)
- Who is your audience (B2B or B2C) and what industry are you in?
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Are you looking for a local agency to meet in person, or is remote OK?
- Timeline / key goals (awareness, leads, sales, launch, rebrand)?

How I can help next
- If you reply with the answers above I’ll produce a short, prioritized shortlist of reputable Kansas City agencies that match your needs (with why each is a fit, estimated pricing range, and questions to ask them).

If you want to start researching on your own, here are fast ways to compare agencies
- Review portfolios and case studies on agency websites (look for measurable results).
- Check independent directories/reviews: Clutch, Google reviews, LinkedIn recommendations.
- Look at industry awards and local recognition (e.g., AdFed KC, Effie finalists, regional ADDYs).
- Ask for references and recent client results (metrics and contactable references).
- Ask for a pilot or short-term test engagement to evaluate fit before a long contract.

Questions to ask any agency you interview
1. Which similar clients/industries have you worked with and what were the results?  
2. Who will be our day-to-day team and what’s their experience?  
3. What KPIs and reporting cadence do you propose?  
4. What does success look like at 3, 6 and 12 months?  
5. What are typical fees / pricing model and what’s included?

If you want, tell me your industry, goals and budget now and I’ll recommend 4–6 Kansas City agencies that are good fits and explain why.
